sloka: त्वं पद्ममिव वातेन सन्नता प्रियदर्शना ।उरस्तेऽभिनिविष्टं वै यावत् स्कन्धात्समुन्नतम् ॥२-९-४१॥
transliteration: tvaṁ padmamiva vātena sannatā priyadarśanā ।uraste'bhiniviṣṭaṁ vai yāvat skandhātsamunnatam ॥2-9-41॥

translations.english: Your breasts are thick and are as high as your shoulders. Beneath them lies your belly with its beautiful navel (waist) looking slender as if out of bashfulness.
